questions.question: In his farewell to Israel's leaders, Joshua said the LORD their God did what for them against the nations in the land?
Joshua told Israel that because the LORD fights for them, one Israelite could put how many enemies to flight?
Joshua warned Israel that if they turned away and clung to the nations left in the land, the LORD would still drive those nations out. True or false?
Joshua warned Israel that the anger of the LORD would burn against them if they did what?

answers.text: Broke His covenant and served other gods
Lost a battle to the nations around them
Left the land to live somewhere else
